messages:
carmen: :exclamation: FYI — NovusBio reached out saying they got charged today even though they canceled mid-cycle. Customer email: billing@novusbio.com. Invoice shows a pro-rata mid-cycle item but amount doesn't match seats. invoice_id: INV-8154, charge_id: ch_3kL7x. Can someone triage?

jake: on it. do we have the cancellation timestamp?

carmen: they said canceled via console on 2025-03-02 14:06 PDT; support case #12387 has screenshot. It looks like the invoice created at 2025-03-15 03:12 UTC (INV-8154) which is after cancel.

sara: I see an invoice.create at 2025-03-15T03:12:18Z from billing-service for sub_9X. There's also a second invoice.create 2s later for the same subscription id. pulling webhook & payment logs now.

eng-billing: initial look — order-service emitted two invoice.create events within ~2s. Both referenced the same subscription but only one idempotency_key present (first event). Second event had null idempotency. Suspect network retry from a downstream webhook consumer.

billing-bot: payment logs snippet:
```
2025-03-15T03:12:20Z charge.attempt ch_3kL7x amount=23500 status=success
2025-03-15T03:12:21Z charge.attempt ch_3kL7x_dup amount=23500 status=success
```
(weird — two successful charge attempts for same card)

jake: :grimacing: that looks bad. can we reconcile transaction ids with PSP? which one is the merchant-referenced id?

ops-oncall: reaching out to PSP now (Stripe team pinged). In parallel, can finance prepare a reversal if this is confirmed duplicate?

finance-walker: I can create a refund/reversal once we have confirmation of duplicate. do we have cardholder name and last4?

carmen: card last4 4242, name: Zoe Patel. I've attached the customer's support screenshot in the ticket. Customer prefers a direct refund to the card.

eng-billing: reproducing locally — the retry came from our webhook relay to payment-worker which did not persist idempotency keys for transient failures. scenario: payment-worker ack failure -> webhook relay retries without original idempotency header -> payment-worker treated as new charge. Added logs:
```
[order-service] -> invoice.create id=INV-8154 idempotency=abc123
[webhook-relay] retry #1 -> dropped-idempotency header
[payment-worker] invoice.create -> created charge ch_3kL7x
[webhook-relay] retry #2 -> no idempotency header -> payment-worker created second charge ch_3kL7x_dup
```

sara: confirmable root cause. engineering fix: make webhook-relay forward idempotency header and add dedupe on payment-worker for invoice.request.external_id within 10s window. I'll open a PR.

billing-bot: PSP reconciliation: stripe_charge_ids -> ["ch_3kL7x","ch_3kL7x_dup"] both settled.

finance-walker: proceeding with reversing the duplicate charge ch_3kL7x_dup. Creating credit note CN-582 and refund for $235.00 back to card. Will need 24-72h for bank settlement.

jake: please also update the customer and mark subscription canceled effective immediately. we should not bill again.

carmen: told customer: "We're so sorry — we found a duplicate mid-cycle charge created by our billing retries. We've issued a refund and a credit note (CN-582). Refund shows as pending with your bank and should clear in 3 business days. We've also confirmed your subscription is canceled and won't be billed further." They replied :relieved: and asked if we can provide a refund reference once complete.

ops-oncall: mitigation deployed: relay now preserves idempotency headers for retry, and payment-worker dedupe window set to 30s. Rolling to prod in 10m.

eng-billing: PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/279 — adds header passthrough + dedupe check. Will monitor metrics.

finance-walker: refund issued: refund_id rf_77B, credit_note CN-582 created. Noted in case #12387.

carmen: thanks team. can we add a short postmortem to incidents channel after we confirm no further duplicates? Also need a customer-facing note for billing status page.

sara: will draft short blameless note and post in incidents. I'll keep monitoring for similar invoice.create duplicates and follow up tomorrow with counts.

jake: great. capture action items: 1) confirm refund clears, 2) monitor duplicate invoice metric for 24h, 3) backfill idempotency for any affected events older than 1h, 4) postmortem draft. Assigning to eng-billing/sara/finance-walker.

carmen: assigning and closing loop with customer. thanks all :tada:
